about: Holidays on the Rails brings a holiday train ride, crafts and a visit with Santa Claus to the National Railroad Museum at 2285 S. Broadway in Green Bay from December 8 to 10, 2026.
Activities run from 9 AM to 2 PM, rain or shine, and the museum stays open until 5 PM. Every ticket includes a train ride, and your ticket time is your ride time.
Afterward families can play holiday games, hunt through an I-Spy scavenger hunt, visit the temporary tattoo station, decorate cookies, try four craft stations and meet Santa.
The day is designed for children in preschool through second grade.
The host is National Railroad Museum.
The address is 2285 S. Broadway, Green Bay, WI 54304.
Cost: $18 for children 2 and over; $16 for adults; museum members free.

about: The National Railroad Museum in Green Bay hosts The Polar Express Train Ride on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays from November 20 through December 13, 2026.
The 2026 shows are sold out, so check the museum for any returned tickets before you go.
The program starts in the Lenfestey Center with the Hot Chocolate Dance, hot chocolate and cookies, and a reading of the original book.
Guests then board a real vintage train for a ride to the North Pole, where Santa visits with passengers.

The address is 2285 S. Broadway, Green Bay, WI 54304.
